body:
P2-29 BUILT, NOT WALKED (PR #107, resumed 16 Nov 18:30 UTC after the first helper died on the usage limit at ~08:40). Fakes only; nothing run on a device, emulator, VM 108 or the network. For the lead and the advisor.

STATE. The first helper's two commits (words/numbers/presenter, then the wiring, the import watch, the Downloads channel, the docs) were complete; its uncommitted review round is finished and committed: (1) a single song is no card even at "Starting..." (the phone's known song count is carried, so the first second of a one-song download is not a card either); (2) an import is keyed by the playlist it made, the SAME key as the Download of that playlist, so pressing Download on a playlist still importing keeps the bar and ends in one result card. New test file card_targets_test.dart reads the targets from real pins and a real database; both behaviours shown load-bearing by mutation (tests red, then green). Merged origin/main (74c17d4: #104 text fold, #108, #109); docs/08 taken from main and regenerated.

GATES on the merged tree: WHOLE app suite 3248 passed 5 skipped; dart analyze --fatal-infos clean; dart format clean; server ruff, ruff format, mypy clean, whole server suite 2112 passed, 13 deselected, 1 xfailed (encore_server.__file__ checked: the worktree); check_rows 162 Built rows, 0 without a test. P2-29 re-marked BUILT (not walked) with that evidence.

DRAWN STATES. All 12 shade frames and the lock screen have a test (table in the PR). Words are exactly the drawn English. One drawing caption amended: the waiting frame's GREY bar is not built (a plain Android card draws its own bar colour; the reason in the words carries the difference); the caption now says so.

DOCS TOUCHED. PB-38 and the D-52 sentence amended earlier; PB-43 (new) names card_targets_test.dart now. Audit rows: B-100 (this item) built-not-walked; B-134 says the Cancel button it describes is GONE with this PR; B-135 says the overclaiming transport comment is corrected, the gap stays N-40.

FOR THE LEAD TO DECIDE.
1. N-39's premise: the only remaining cancel path I read is download_manager.dart's _transport.cancel on unpin (deletes the files). The shade's Cancel is gone, so a person can no longer reach the restart from the shade; the manager's handling of TransferStatus.canceled is still unproven. Is another cancel path known that reaches it?
2. A merged import + Download whose import is stopped elsewhere shows no "Import stopped" card (the download goes on, its line is the download's). Accept, or draw it.
3. PROPER FIX to file: the server should publish import.progress (or keep.progress for the import's playlist) when the keeper stores a song of an import; then the 10 s asking while an import is saving can go.
4. READ, not run, still: the <=4-file tail after a kill and Notifications.kt:629. Not done on purpose: 6-hourly job, Stop button (N-39), legacy ImportsController, Arabic (N-41).
